comparison.objective: Store glasses upright in a sliding-lid box after separating keys.
comparison.physical_skill: Clear a lid, slide it on rails, place a thin fragile object upright, and close it near an obstacle.
comparison.success_condition: Keys in dish, glasses upright in box, lid closed, mug undisturbed, and no dropped items.
comparison.reason: Tests sorting, fragile placement, and sliding closure rather than impact-driven material separation.
